blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-hop knowledge-graph question answering (KGQA) benchmarks are often treated as fixed language-and-reasoning tasks, but for navigation-based methods, difficulty also depends on the graph in which those tasks are instantiated. This makes graph construction a consequential but often entangled part of the navigation task. To isolate this effect, we audit PathQuestion (PQ) and PathQuestion-Large (PQL) as graph-navigation benchmarks under a controlled intervention: we hold questions, topic entities, released answers, released path annotations, and family-level splits fixed while replacing each released task-filtered graph with the larger source KG distributed with the benchmark. Source restoration expands the effective navigation search space and graph-consistent answer and path multiplicity while sharply reducing unguided reachability to released answers. We evaluate whether these structural changes persist across navigation policies using structural references, frozen small-language-model navigation policies, and trained MINERVA policies. Across both frozen and trained policies, restoration substantially reduces released-answer accuracy and trajectory fidelity, while graph-consistent evaluation recovers only part of the loss. These results show that benchmark graph construction is part of the navigation task specification rather than merely an implementation detail and can materially shape measured behavior even when the released QA task is held fixed.
blocks.zh: 多跳知识-图解答(KGQA)基准往往被视为固定的语言和推理任务,但对于以导航为基础的方法,难度也取决于这些任务被即时化的图表. 这使得图表构造成为导航任务中必然而常被缠绕的部分. 为了隔离这种效果,我们审计路径问题(PQ)和路径问题-Large(PQL)作为受控干预下的图导航基准:我们持有问题,主题实体,发布答案,发布路径说明,以及家庭层面分拆固定,同时将每个已发布的任务过滤图替换为与基准分配的较大源KG. 源恢复扩展了有效的导航搜索空间和与图形一致的答案和路径多端,同时将解出答案的无导可达性急剧降低. 我们评价这些结构性变化是否在各种导航政策中持续,使用结构参考、冻结的小型语言模型导航政策以及训练有素的MInerVA政策。 无论是冻结政策还是训练有素的政策,恢复都大大减少了释放的准确度和轨迹可靠性,而与图表一致的评价只弥补了部分损失。 这些结果显示,基准图表构建是导航任务规格的一部分,而不仅仅是一个执行细节,即使释放的QA任务被固定,也可以在物质上塑造被测量的行为.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Multi-hop knowledge-graph question answering (KGQA) asks a model to combine a natural-language question with a sequence of graph relations to reach one or more answer entities.
PathQuestion (PQ) and PathQuestion-Large (PQL), introduced with the Interpretable Reasoning Network (IRN) Zhou et al. (2018) , are long-standing benchmarks for this setting and have been used to study multi-relation reasoning over compact knowledge graphs.
For graph-navigation methods such as MINERVA Das et al. (2018) , however, the graph is not passive background context: it directly defines the legal actions available at every reasoning step.
A benchmark can therefore become easier, harder, or simply different when its graph is filtered, even if the question text and intended relation chain do not change.
The present study asks a different question: what changes when the released Question-Answer (QA) tasks are placed back into the larger source/original knowledge graphs that accompany the benchmark artifacts? We treat this graph restoration as a controlled intervention rather than as a benchmark redesign.
blocks.zh:
多跳知识-图解答(KGQA) 问出一个模式,将自然语言问题与图解关系序列结合起来,以达到一个或多个解答实体.
PathQuestion(PQ)和PathQuest-Large(PQL)由可解释理性网(IRN)周等(2018年)所引入,是这种设置的长期基准,被用来研究多关系推理而不是紧凑的知识图.
然而,对于MINERVA Das等人(2018年)等图导航方法,该图并非被动的背景背景:它直接定义了每个推理步骤中可用的法律行动.
因此,一个基准在被过滤出其图表时会变得更加容易、更难,或者完全不同,即使问题文本和打算建立的关系链不会改变。
本研究提出了一个不同的问题:当释放出的问题-答复(QA)任务重新放入基准文物所附的较大来源/原始知识图时,有什么变化? 我们把恢复这个图表视为一种有控制的干预,而不是重新设计基准。

blocks.en:
Each PQ/PQL question specifies a topic entity and an intended sequence of relation types leading toward one or more answers.
We refer to this sequence as a relation chain , and to a concrete alternating sequence of entities and relations realizing that chain in the graph as a path .
Related surface questions that correspond to the same underlying navigation problem are grouped into a structural family to prevent related variants from crossing split boundaries and to give each family equal weight in evaluation.
For each QA instance, we keep fixed the natural-language question, topic entity, evaluation horizon, released valid-answer set, one or more released relation chains, structural-family identity, and split assignment.
We then change only the active navigation graph from the released task-filtered graph G F G_{F} to the distributed source graph G S G_{S} .
The primary evaluation continues to use the released answer and path annotations in both conditions, isolating the effect of changing the graph from changes to the evaluation target.
Separately, we enumerate graph-consistent answers and paths: endpoints and path realizations obtained by following the same released relation chains in the active graph.

blocks.en:
This distinction is important because PQ/PQL contain repeated surface variants, multiple valid answers, cyclic or immediately backtracking reference paths, and, in PQL, a small number of QA instances with more than one released relation chain.
Collapsing these cases into a single designated path, removing repeated-node trajectories, or evaluating every textual variant as an independent structural problem can distort both the measured difficulty of the benchmark and the apparent behavior of the evaluated models.
We therefore reconstruct the benchmarks using family-level split control and multi-reference annotations while preserving the released trajectories.
blocks.zh:
这种区分很重要,因为PQ/PQL包含重复的表面变体,多个有效的答案,循环或即时回溯的参考路径,在PQL中,少数QA例包含不止一个被放出的关系链.
把这些案例折叠成一个单一的指定路径,去除重复的节点轨迹,或将每个文本变体评价为一个独立的结构问题,既会扭曲基准的测量难度,也会扭曲被评价模型的明显行为.
因此,我们利用家庭层面的分化控制和多参考说明来重建基准,同时保留已发布的轨迹。

blocks.en:
Contributions .
Our contributions are threefold: • Intervention .
We formulate source restoration as a matched intervention that isolates the effect of graph construction by holding the released QA task fixed while changing only the active navigation graph. • Reconstruction .
We provide a family-controlled reconstruction of PQ/PQL that preserves multiple released references and cyclic trajectories while making graph-induced answer and path multiplicity explicit.
As the original benchmarks lack an explicit redistribution license, we release the reconstruction code rather than the reconstructed datasets. 1 1 1 https://github.com/HalcyonSolutions/PathQuestion-Family The code reproduces the benchmark versions used in this study from the original released artifacts. • Empirical Evidence .
We evaluate the intervention using structural references, frozen small-language-model navigation policies, and trained MINERVA policies, measuring both answer accuracy and trajectory fidelity with the path-fidelity metrics introduced for traceable KG navigation in prior work Hernandez et al. (2026b) .
We complement these fixed released targets with graph-consistent diagnostics that identify newly realizable answers and paths in the restored graph. Across these settings, source restoration consistently changes answer reachability and trajectory fidelity, showing that benchmark graph construction is a consequential part of the navigation task specification.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work and Benchmark History
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作和基准历史

blocks.en:
PathQuestion and PathQuestion-Large were introduced with IRN as separate 2-hop and 3-hop benchmarks generated from Freebase subsets by extracting relation paths and rendering them through handcrafted templates with synonym and paraphrase variation Zhou et al. (2018) .
IRN characterizes PQL as the more challenging variant because it uses a larger KG while providing fewer training instances.
Thus, “Large” refers to the graph rather than to the number of QA examples.
The released artifacts additionally distinguish hop-specific task-filtered KGs from larger source/original KGs, a distinction that motivates the controlled restoration studied here.
UHop Chen et al. (2019) later combined the 2-hop and 3-hop variants as PQ+ and PQL+ to evaluate unrestricted-hop reasoning and learned stopping, while also noting the benchmarks’ small graphs, repetitive relations, and template-generated language.
SRN Qiu et al. (2020) adopted a similar mixed-hop setting under the names PQ-M and PQL-M, formulating the task as weakly supervised sequential decision making.
Our reconstruction follows this mixed-hop setting while adding family-level split control and retaining all released annotation references associated with each reconstructed QA instance.
Because these systems use different multi-hop reasoning formulations, their reported mixed-hop results should not be interpreted as measuring a common notion of explicit graph-navigation performance.
Appendix C discusses this distinction when relating their published results to our reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
PathQuestion and PathQuestion-Large被引入了由IRN作为由Freebase子集生成的独立的2-hop和3-hop基准,其方法是取出关系路径并用同义词和同义词变体"周等"(2018)的手动模板来渲染.
IRN将PQL定性为更具挑战性的变体,因为它使用更大的KG,同时提供较少的培训实例.
因此,“大”是指图表,而不是质量保证实例的数目。
所释放的文物还额外区分了hop特有任务过滤的KG和更大的源/原出KG,这种区分激励了这里所研究的控制修复.

我们的重建遵循这种混合模式,同时增加家庭层面的分化控制,并保留与每个重建的QA实例相关的所有已发布的注释引用。
由于这些系统使用不同的多跳推理配方,因此其所报的混合跳出结果不应被解释为测量一个明确的图导航性能的共同概念.
附 录 C在将公布的结果与我们的重建联系起来时讨论了这种区别。

blocks.en:
Answer multiplicity is already part of the original benchmark design: IRN evaluates predictions against a valid answer set for one-to-many relations Zhou et al. (2018) .
MRP-QA Wang et al. (2022) further studies alternative reasoning paths in PQL by enumerating paths of at most three hops from the topic entity to the answer, reporting multiple valid paths for substantial portions of PQL-2H and PQL-3H, 12.5% and 45.2% respectively.
Our focus is therefore not the existence of multiple answers or paths, but how their graph-realizable multiplicity changes when the released task graph is replaced by the larger source graph while the released relation-chain annotations remain fixed.
blocks.zh:
答多已经是原始基准设计的一部分: IRN根据一对多关系周等(2018)的有效答案集来评价预测.
MRP-QA Wang等编. (2022)进一步研究PQL的可选推理路径,列举从主题实体到答案的最多3个跳出路径,报告PQL-2H和PQL-3H的很大一部分,分别为12.5%和45.2%。
因此,我们的重点不是存在多个答案或路径,而是当所发布的任务图被更大的源图所取代而所发布的关系链注释仍然固定时,它们的图形可实现的多重变化.

blocks.en:
Prior work has also changed the graph supporting PQ/PQL, but mainly by deleting information from the released task graph.
IRN evaluates an incomplete-KG condition after removing half of the PQ-2H triples Zhou et al. (2018) , and QA2MN Li et al. (2022) similarly evaluates robustness when only half of the original task-graph triples are retained.
These interventions ask whether a model can tolerate missing support.
They are not equivalent to source restoration, which moves in the opposite direction and can introduce additional branches, intermediate entities, answer endpoints, and shortcuts that were suppressed by benchmark filtering.
blocks.zh:
先前的工作也改变了支持PQ/PQL的图表,但主要是从已发布的任务图中删除信息.
IRN在移除了半个PQ-2H 三相周等(2018)后评价了一个不完全-KG条件,而QA2MN李等. (2022年)同样评价了当原有任务图三分之一只保留了一半时的稳健性.
这些干预措施询问一个模式是否能够容忍缺少支持。
它们不等同于源恢复,源恢复方向相反,可以引入额外的分支,中间实体,解答端点,以及被基准过滤所压制的快捷键.

blocks.en:
Later work continues to use the hop-specific and mixed variants.
For example, HyperMR reports PQ-2H, PQ-3H, PQ-M and their PQL counterparts Wang et al. (2024) .
Prior work on traceable multi-hop graph navigation Hernandez et al. (2026b) established the structural calibration tools reused here: exact RW-Ans p , its Monte Carlo estimate RW-Ans MC , the answer-oracle Shortest Path reference, and the PED, RED, F1 SG , and F1 REL trajectory metrics.
That study’s Appendix C already applies the random-walk diagnostics and local-navigation statistics to release-derived mixed PQ/PQL graphs.
A concurrent study of small language models evaluates isolated iterative graph navigation beyond answer accuracy Hernandez et al. (2026a) .
We reuse both the established calibration suite and the frozen-SLM navigation protocol, but apply them to a different experimental question: how navigation changes under a matched filtered-versus-source graph intervention with fixed released QA semantics.

后来的作品继续使用hop特有和混合变种.
例如,HyperMR报告PQ-2H、PQ-3H、PQ-M及其PQL对应方Wang等人(2024年)。
先前关于可追踪多跳图导航赫尔南德斯等(2026年b)的工作确立了在此重用的结构校正工具:准确的RW-Ans p.,它的Monte Carlo估计RW-Ans MC.,解答-oracle最短路径参考,以及PED,RED,F1 SG,和F1 REL轨迹测量.
该研究报告的附录 C已经将随机行走诊断和局部导航统计应用于释放出混合PQ/PQL图.
对小语言模型同时进行的一项研究评价了孤立的迭接图导航,超出了答案精度赫尔南德斯等 (2026a).
我们重新使用既有的校正套件和被冻结的-SLM导航协议,但将它们应用于不同的实验性问题:在匹配的被过滤出与源图干涉下,在固定放出QA语义下,导航是如何变化的.

blocks.en:
Prior work therefore covers PQ/PQL construction, mixed-hop stopping, templated language, incomplete-KG robustness, answer multiplicity, alternative reasoning paths, and structural navigation diagnostics.
To the best of our review, however, we did not find a study that holds the released questions, topic entities, relation-chain annotations, split/family assignment, and released answer target fixed while replacing the released task-filtered graph with the distributed source/original knowledge graph.
Our contribution is this matched environmental substitution and its effect on benchmark navigability, rather than a first general audit of PQ/PQL.
blocks.zh:
因此,先前的工作涵盖PQ/PQL构建,混合跳停,模板语言,不完全-KG稳健性,答题多重性,替代推理路径,以及结构导航诊断.
然而,在我们的审查中,我们没有找到一项研究,将发布的问题、主题实体、关系链说明、分/家庭任务以及发布的答复目标固定下来,同时用分布式源/原始知识图取代发布的任务过滤图。
我们的贡献是环境替代及其对于基准导航性的影响,而不是对PQ/PQL的第一次总审计。

blocks.en:
We adopt the structural and trajectory-evaluation protocol of prior work Hernandez et al. (2026b) rather than introduce a new metric suite.
RW-Ans p is the exact fixed-horizon probability that a uniform random walker over labeled legal actions terminates in the valid answer set, while RW-Ans MC is its Monte Carlo estimate based on sampled walks.
The same work defines an answer-oracle Shortest Path structural reference that is given the topic entity, navigation graph, and valid answer set, but not the annotated reasoning path, and deterministically selects a shortest route to any valid answer.
We likewise reuse Path Edit Distance (PED) and entity/subgraph overlap F1 SG for path fidelity: PED is the Levenshtein distance between the ordered predicted and reference edge sequences, while F ​ 1 SG F1_{\mathrm{SG}} measures their order-invariant edge overlap.
Together, these metrics capture complementary aspects of trajectory fidelity: ordered path agreement and order-invariant edge overlap.
When multiple released entity-level paths or relation chains are valid, our multi-annotated evaluation takes the minimum edit distance or maximum overlap over the valid released references.
This audit therefore changes the graph condition and valid-reference bookkeeping, not the definitions of RW-Ans p , RW-Ans MC , the Shortest Path reference, or the path-fidelity metrics.
As previously noted Hernandez et al. (2026b) , the Shortest Path reference is not a path-fidelity upper bound because a graph-theoretic shortcut can reach a correct answer while disagreeing with the released reasoning chain.

Table 3 summarizes entity revisits and immediate backtracking in the original released annotations, before question-family aggregation.
An entity revisit occurs when a path visits an entity more than once, whereas an immediate backtrack returns to the entity visited two positions earlier.
Both behaviors are prevalent, particularly in PQL three-hop annotations, where nearly all reference paths revisit an entity.
Relatedly, the topic entity itself belongs to the released answer set for 33.0% of PQL released records, so answer reachability can include a valid zero-length solution even when the released reasoning annotation follows a multi-hop walk.
Appendix A.2 provides the full breakdown.
These behaviors expose a benchmark-design concern for future multi-hop KGQA datasets because they can weaken the alignment between the surface question, the annotated reasoning chain, and the navigation actually required to reach a valid answer.
In particular, cyclic or self-returning annotations can make the nominal multi-hop trajectory unnecessary for answer retrieval, raising questions about whether the assigned hop count reflects required multi-hop reasoning.
This concern is especially apparent when the topic entity itself is a released answer, since the benchmark can admit a valid zero-length solution despite providing a multi-hop reference trajectory.
Appendix E separately examines wording-related irregularities that can further affect the interpretation of the released questions.
For the present audit, however, these properties are part of the released benchmark and must remain unchanged.
We therefore preserve the released walk semantics rather than imposing a no-repeated-entity constraint, which would alter the reference reasoning trajectories and the task being audited.

blocks.en:
Tables 4 and 5 show that source restoration sharply reduces both released-answer reachability and trajectory fidelity for RW-Ans MC on PQ and PQL.
The contrast is especially pronounced for PQL, where RW-Ans MC attains 54.1 % 54.1\% released-answer H@1 on the filtered graph despite using unguided uniform navigation, before falling to 7.8 % 7.8\% under source restoration.
Its path fidelity deteriorates in parallel, indicating that the filtered PQL graph makes both released endpoints and the released reasoning trajectories unusually accessible to unguided navigation.
Under source restoration, random-walk trajectory fidelity also moves close to the low-fidelity end of both metrics, with PED approaching 3 3 and F1 SG approaching 0 0 under the fixed three-action horizon.
This deterioration is more pronounced for PQ than PQL, indicating particularly weak agreement between unguided source-graph trajectories and the released PQ reasoning paths.
The corresponding exact random-walk calibration and additional structural statistics are reported in Appendix B.1 .

blocks.en:
The answer-oracle Shortest Path reference reaches a released answer by construction, so its H@1 remains 1.00 1.00 in both graph conditions.
Its trajectory-fidelity metrics are therefore the more informative comparison.
For PQ, source restoration substantially degrades Shortest Path agreement with the released trajectories.
PQL exhibits a different pattern.
On the filtered graph, Shortest Path has lower path fidelity than RW-Ans MC , despite its guaranteed endpoint success.
Notably, an answer-informed shortest route therefore agrees less closely with the released reasoning trajectories than an unguided uniform random walk.
This result is consistent with the cyclic and backtracking structure documented in Section 4 , where the shortest route to a released answer need not reproduce the annotated multi-hop walk.
After source restoration, Shortest Path fidelity degrades only slightly, while random-walk fidelity deteriorates sharply, leaving the shortest routes substantially more faithful to the released trajectories.
This reversal further shows that endpoint accessibility and agreement with the released reasoning trajectory are distinct properties whose relationship depends on the active graph.
Complete Shortest Path trajectory metrics are reported in Appendix B.2 .

blocks.zh: 5.2 冻结和学习到的政策对图表条件仍然敏感

blocks.en:
Tables 4 and 5 additionally report results for both frozen and trainable policies.
Across all three frozen SLMs, source restoration reduces released-answer accuracy and trajectory fidelity on both benchmarks.
The agreement in direction across independently frozen policies indicates that the effect is not specific to one SLM.
blocks.zh:
表4和表5还报告了冻结政策和可培训政策的结果。
在所有三个被冻结的可持续土地管理中,源头恢复降低了两个基准的解答准确性和轨迹可靠性。
跨独立冻结政策方向的协议表明,这种影响并非专门针对一个可持续土地管理。

blocks.en:
MINERVA shows the same qualitative sensitivity after training on each active graph.
The PQL result is particularly informative because source-graph endpoint accuracy remains comparatively strong while agreement with the released reasoning trajectories deteriorates substantially.
Selecting hyperparameters on the source development graph improves some source-graph metrics relative to the matched filtered-dev configuration but does not recover filtered-graph performance.
The filtered-to-source change therefore persists after allowing the trainable policy a condition-matched tuning control.
blocks.zh:
MINERVA在对每个活动图表进行培训后表现出同样的质量敏感性。
PQL结果尤其具有信息性,因为源图端点的准确性仍然比较强,而与所释放的推理轨迹的一致则大大恶化.
在源代码开发图上选择超参数,相对于匹配的被过滤-dev配置,可以改进一些源代码测量,但不会恢复被过滤-graph性能.
因此,在允许可训练政策采用条件相匹配的调制控制后,过滤到源的改变继续存在。

blocks.en:
Across the filtered conditions, PQL also yields higher released-answer H@1 than PQ for RW-Ans MC , all three frozen SLMs, and MINERVA despite its larger graph and broader relation vocabulary.
This consistent reversal shows that overall graph size and relation-vocabulary size are not reliable proxies for released-answer accessibility , which is shaped by the structure of the active navigation graph.
blocks.zh:
在经过过滤的条件中,PQL对RW-Ans MC、所有三种被冻结的可持续土地管理和MInerVA的解答H@1也比PQ高,尽管其图表更大,关系词汇范围更广。
这种一致的倒转显示,总体的图大小和关系-vobulary大小对于释放出答案的可访问性来说并不可靠,后者由活性导航图的结构所塑造.

blocks.en: 5.3 Graph-consistent evaluation explains only part of the degradation
blocks.zh: 5.3 与图表一致的评价只是部分降解的原因

blocks.en:
Graph-consistent evaluation distinguishes disagreement with the released answer and path references from endpoints and trajectories that remain consistent with the released relation chains but become newly realizable after source restoration.
Across random walking, the frozen policies, and MINERVA, evaluating against A graph A_{\mathrm{graph}} recovers part of the released-answer loss on the source graph.
This recovery shows that some predictions counted as incorrect under A released A_{\mathrm{released}} nevertheless reach endpoints consistent with the same released relation chains in the restored graph.
The effect is not uniform across models or benchmarks.
For MINERVA, the recovery is substantial on PQ but comparatively small on PQL, indicating that graph-induced answer expansion explains only part of the filtered-to-source performance gap.

对于MInerVA来说,PQ的回收量很大,但PQL的回收量相对较小,这表明由图表引起的答案扩展只是部分被过滤到源性能差距的原因.

blocks.en:
The same distinction applies to trajectories.
Evaluation against P graph P_{\mathrm{graph}} recovers part of the source-graph path-fidelity loss, particularly on PQ, while the recovery for MINERVA on PQL is much smaller.
Appendix B.3 reports the complete graph-consistent trajectory evaluation.
We therefore treat A graph A_{\mathrm{graph}} and P graph P_{\mathrm{graph}} as complementary graph-relative diagnostics rather than replacements for the fixed released benchmark targets.

同样区别也适用于轨迹.

因此,我们将图表A_{\mathrm{graph}和P graphmathrm{graph}视为补充的图表关系诊断,而不是固定释放基准目标的替代。

blocks.en: 5.4 Cross-graph transfer reveals environment specialization
blocks.zh: 5.4 交叉传输显示环境专业化

blocks.en:
Appendix D evaluates trained MINERVA checkpoints across graph conditions without destination-graph retuning.
Policies trained on G F G_{F} degrade substantially when transferred to G S G_{S} , whereas policies trained on G S G_{S} transfer more favorably to G F G_{F} .
Because the released targets remain available and the entity and relation vocabularies are fixed across conditions, this asymmetry cannot be explained by target disappearance or an out-of-vocabulary mismatch.
The transfer results therefore provide additional evidence that learned navigation policies specialize to the graph environment in which they are trained.
blocks.zh:
附 录 D对经过培训的MIREVA检查站进行跨图式评估,不进行目的地图重新调整。
接受过GF GQQF 训练的政策在转至GS GQS 时会大幅下降,而接受过GS GQS 训练的政策则更倾向于转至GF GQF .
由于释放出的目标仍然可用,实体和关系词汇是跨条件固定的,因此这种不对称不能由目标消失或离地不匹配来解释.
因此,转移结果提供了更多的证据,说明所学习的导航政策专门用于培训他们的图表环境。

blocks.en:
The combined structural, frozen-policy, trained-policy, graph-consistent, and transfer results do not imply that a larger graph is uniformly harder to navigate.
Instead, they show that changing the active graph changes the decision problem induced by the same released QA task.
Branching, reachable-state volume, answer and path multiplicity, unguided answer reachability, learned endpoint accuracy, and trajectory fidelity all respond to this intervention.
The active graph should therefore be treated as part of the benchmark specification rather than as an interchangeable implementation artifact.
blocks.zh:
综合结构、冻结政策、训练有素的政策、与图表一致和转移结果并不意味着更大的图表统一起来更难浏览。
相反,它们显示,改变活性图会改变由同样被放出QA任务所引发的决策问题.
分支化、可达到状态的体积、答案和路径的多面性、无指导的答案可达到性、学到的终点准确性以及轨迹的忠实性都对这一干预作出反应。
因此,应将活性图视为基准规格的一部分,而不是可互换的执行文物。

blocks.en:
The released PQ/PQL graphs remain useful controlled environments, but results obtained on them should be interpreted in light of their graph construction, generated language, answer annotations, and path conventions.
In particular, high accuracy on the filtered graph does not establish equivalent navigation behavior on the distributed source KG or faithful recovery of the released reasoning trajectories.
Appendix F summarizes cautions for interpreting and comparing results obtained on PQ/PQL.
blocks.zh:
所发布的PQ/PQL图仍然是有用的控制环境,但所获得的结果应当根据其图解构造、生成的语言、解答说明和路径惯例来解释。
特别是被过滤图的高精度并不能在分布源上建立等同的导航行为KG或忠实地恢复所释放出推理轨迹.
附 录 F总结了解释和比较在PQ/PQL上取得的成果的告诫。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We audited PathQuestion and PathQuestion-Large by treating source-graph restoration as a controlled intervention that changes the active navigation environment while keeping the released QA task fixed.
Restoration substantially expands the effective navigation search space, increases graph-consistent answer and path multiplicity, reduces unguided reachability to released answers, and lowers shortest-path agreement with the released reasoning traces.
These structural changes persist across three frozen SLM policies and trained MINERVA policies, showing that the effect is not limited to a model-free calibration.
blocks.zh:
我们审计了PathQuestion and PathQuestion-Large,将源图修复视为一种可控的干预,可以改变活性导航环境,同时保持发布的QA任务固定.
恢复大幅扩展了有效的导航搜索空间,增加了与图表一致的答案和路径的多面性,减少了对所发布答案的无导可达性,并降低了与所发布推理痕迹的最短路径一致.
这些结构变化在三项被冻结的可持续土地管理政策和经过培训的MIREVA政策中持续存在,表明其效果并不限于无模型校正。

blocks.en:
The completed learned-policy experiments sharpen the distinction between endpoint success and trajectory fidelity.
MINERVA retains relatively strong source-graph answer accuracy on PQL while its agreement with the released paths degrades substantially.
Graph-consistent evaluation recovers part of the apparent answer and path loss by crediting newly realizable endpoints and trajectories that satisfy the same released relation chains, but the recovery is incomplete and strongly benchmark-dependent.
Cross-graph transfer provides an additional control.
Filtered-trained policies degrade sharply when moved to the restored source graph, whereas source-trained policies remain comparable or improve when the graph is contracted to the filtered environment.
Because the released targets remain available in both KGs, this asymmetry isolates sensitivity to the surrounding graph structure rather than target disappearance.
blocks.zh:
已完成的学习政策实验进一步明确了终点成功与轨迹忠实之间的区别。
MINERVA在PQL上保留了相对强烈的源图解答精度,而它与所放出路径的一致则大幅下降.
与图相符合的评价通过入计新可实现的端点和轨迹来回收部分明显答案和路径损失,这些端点和轨迹满足了相同的已放出的关系链,但回收是不完整的并强烈依赖基准.
交叉传输提供了额外的控制.
过滤训练后的政策在移入已恢复的源图时会急剧下降,而受源图训练后的政策在与被过滤的环境收缩时仍然具有可比性或有所改善。
由于释放出的目标在两种KG中仍然可用,这种不对称隔离了对周围图表结构的敏感性,而不是目标消失.

blocks.en:
These results show that benchmark graph construction is a consequential part of the navigation task specification.
PQ/PQL remain useful controlled benchmarks, but their filtered graphs, cyclic path conventions, multiple valid references, and family structure must be made explicit when results are interpreted or compared.
The central implication is not that source graphs are universally harder.
It is that the same nominal multi-hop QA task can induce materially different navigation behavior when the graph defining the legal actions changes.
Future KGQA benchmarks and evaluations should therefore report graph provenance and filtering, represent multiple released and graph-consistent answers and paths explicitly, and separate released-target performance from graph-relative structural validity.
blocks.zh:
这些结果表明,基准图表构建是导航任务规格的一个相应部分。
PQ/PQL仍然是有用的可控基准,但在解释或比较结果时,必须明确其过滤的图表、循环路径惯例、多重有效参考和家族结构。
其核心含义并不是源图普遍较难.
正是同一种名义上的多跳QA任务在定义法律动作的图表改变时,可以诱发实质上不同的导航行为.
因此,未来的KGQA基准和评价应报告图表出处和过滤情况,明确代表多种发布和图表一致的答案和路径,并将发布的目标性能与图表相对的结构有效性分开。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
This study focuses on PathQuestion (PQ) and PathQuestion-Large (PQL), and its findings may not generalize directly to other multi-hop KGQA benchmarks with different graph construction
procedures, question distributions, or annotation conventions.
blocks.zh:
本研究侧重于PathQuestion(PQ)和PathQuestion-Large(PQL),其研究结果可能不会被直接概括到其他多跳KGQA基准,且图形构造不同.
程序、问题分发或说明公约。

blocks.en:
Our source-graph intervention uses the larger knowledge graphs distributed with the original benchmark artifacts. These graphs should not be interpreted as complete versions of Freebase.
Consequently, the analysis measures the effects of restoring the available source graphs rather than those of removing all possible benchmark filtering.
blocks.zh:
我们的源图干预使用与原始基准文物一起分布的较大知识图. 这些图表不应被解释为Freebase的完整版本.
因此,分析衡量的是恢复现有源图的效果,而不是取消所有可能的基准过滤的效果。

blocks.en:
Graph-consistent answers and paths are defined by the released relation-chain annotations.
Although this provides a reproducible structural criterion, it does not guarantee that every newly reachable endpoint is semantically correct for the natural-language question.
We therefore retain the released answers and paths as the primary evaluation targets.
blocks.zh:
图形一致的答案和路径由已发布的关系链说明所定义.
虽然这提供了一个可再生的结构标准,但并不能保证每一个能被新到达的终点对自然语言问题来说都绝对正确.
因此,我们保留公布的答案和路径作为首要评价目标。

blocks.en:
Finally, our policy-based evaluation covers a limited selection of frozen small language models and trained MINERVA policies under a fixed navigation horizon.
Other architectures, training procedures, or adaptive stopping strategies may respond differently to graph restoration.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们基于政策的评价包括有限选择被冻结的小语言模式,并在固定的导航视野下培训MIREVA政策。
其他结构、培训程序或适应性停止战略可能对图修复作出不同的反应。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en:
This study uses publicly released KGQA benchmarks and does not collect new personal data.
The underlying knowledge graphs may contain factual errors, omissions, or biases inherited from their sources.
We distinguish graph-consistent answers from released benchmark answers to avoid overstating model correctness or semantic validity.
blocks.zh:
本研究采用公开发布的KGQA基准,不收集新的个人数据.
基本知识图可能包含事实错误、遗漏或从其来源继承的偏见。
我们把符合图表的答案与发布的基准答案区分开来,以避免对模型的正确性或语义有效性进行高估.

blocks.en: A.2 Topic–answer identity and cyclic structure
blocks.zh: A.2 专题回答身份和循环结构

blocks.en:
Table 6 reports how often the topic entity is itself a released answer, broken down by annotated hop count.
The phenomenon is relatively limited in PQ but is a substantial property of PQL, particularly among its 3-hop instances.
It also persists after family aggregation, affecting 76 PQ families and 592 PQL families.
For answer-based evaluation, the relevant case is whether the topic belongs to the released answer set, since any member of that set constitutes a valid endpoint.
When this occurs, an answer-oracle shortest-path procedure can legitimately select the topic itself and return a zero-length trajectory even though the released annotation follows a 2- or 3-hop walk.
For example, PQ Question 18 asks “who is the child of shah_shuja ’s parent?” , and its released reference path returns to the topic entity after 2 hops.
Likewise, PQL Question 1168 asks “what is the recording of recording of Robin_Hood ’s recording?” , and its released 3-hop reference path remains at the topic entity throughout.
These examples illustrate that shortest answer reachability and agreement with the annotated reasoning trajectory are distinct properties, especially in the presence of cyclic and immediate-backtracking structure.

blocks.en: A.3 Graph-consistent answer and path expansion
blocks.zh: A.3 图表一致的答案和路径扩展

blocks.en:
The reconstructed representation stores released answer and path references separately from graph-relative realizations of the released relation chains.
This distinction is necessary for the controlled intervention because the released answers and reference paths remain fixed across G F G_{F} and G S G_{S} , while the set of graph-consistent endpoints and trajectories induced by those same relation chains can expand with the active graph.
Source restoration therefore does not replace the benchmark target.
Instead, it reveals additional entities and paths that satisfy the released structural annotation in the restored KG.
blocks.zh:
重建后的代表商店发布了解答和路径引用,与解脱关系链的图相关联实现分开.
这种区分对于被控制的干预是必要的,因为释放的答案和参考路径仍然固定在GF G_{F}和GS G_{S}之间,而由同一种关系链所引出的一系列与图形一致的终点和轨迹随着活性图的扩展而得以扩展.
因此,源头恢复不会取代基准目标。
相反,它揭示了满足被恢复的KG中释放的结构注释的其他实体和路径.

blocks.en:
PQ Question 18 provides a concrete example.
The question asks “who is the child of shah_shuja ’s parent?” , corresponding to a 2-hop parent-to-child relation chain.
In the filtered graph, the released realization returns to shah_shuja , making the topic entity the released answer.
In the source graph, following the same relation chain additionally reaches aurangzeb , dara_shikoh , and murad_baksh , all of whom are historically documented siblings of shah_shuja .
The graph-consistent answer set therefore expands to
{ shah_shuja , aurangzeb , dara_shikoh , murad_baksh },
while the original released answer and reference path remain unchanged.
A complementary example appears in PQL Question 1064, which asks “what is the parents of Spider-Man_2 ’s award nominations?” The released 2-hop annotations follow the relation chain award_nominations → \rightarrow parents , passing through Sam_Raimi to reach Leonard_Ronald_Raimi and Celia_Barbara_Abrams .
In the source graph, the same relation chain additionally passes through Michael_Chabon , reaching his parents, Robert_Chabon and Sharon_Chabon .
The graph-consistent answer set thus expands from two released answers to four endpoints, while the number of corresponding path realizations increases from two released references to four source-graph paths.
Unlike the PQ example, where the additional endpoints arise through the same family relation, the PQL expansion introduces an additional intermediate entity that satisfies the released relation chain.
Both examples illustrate that graph restoration can expose additional graph-consistent trajectories and endpoints while preserving the original released answers and reference paths.

This expansion has two important consequences for evaluation.
First, graph-relative evaluation can recognize additional endpoints and trajectories that realize the released relation chains rather than treating every deviation from the released realization as an error.
This is particularly important after source restoration, where a policy may follow a trajectory that was unavailable in G F G_{F} but is structurally consistent with the same released relation chain in G S G_{S} .
We therefore retain the released references as the primary fixed target while using graph-consistent answers and paths as complementary measures of behavior that is valid in the active KG.
Appendix B.3 evaluates the source-graph model trajectories against these graph-consistent path references.
blocks.zh:
这种扩大对评价有两个重要后果。
首先,相图相通的评价可以识别额外的端点和轨迹,这些端点和轨迹可以实现已放出的关系链,而不是把与已放出实现相通的每一个偏差都当作一个错误来对待.

blocks.en:
Second, restoration can introduce alternative realizations of released answers that reduce their dependence on cyclic or self-returning navigation.
The released annotations themselves do not change, so their entity revisits and immediate backtracking remain fixed.
However, additional graph structure can make the same released answer reachable through an alternative realization of the annotated relation chain that does not revisit any entity.
This effect is substantial for PQ, where the number of evaluation instances containing at least one cycle-dependent released answer decreases from 2,710 under G F G_{F} to 2,100 under G S G_{S} .
The corresponding change is negligible for PQL, indicating that its released answers remain much more dependent on repeated-entity traversal after source restoration.
Graph restoration can therefore reduce dependence on cyclic navigation without removing the cyclic structure of the original benchmark annotations.
blocks.zh:
第二,还原可以引入解出答案的替代实现,减少其对循环或自返导航的依赖.

因此图还原可以减少对循环导航的依赖,而不会去掉原基准说明的循环结构.

blocks.en:
For historical context, Table 10 places evaluation-instance micro Hits@1 for MINERVA on our filtered mixed-hop reconstruction alongside previously reported mixed-hop PQ/PQL results.
We use instance-micro aggregation in this table only to align as closely as possible with the conventional instance-weighted reporting in the earlier literature.
The comparison is not controlled because UHop and SRN construct mixed-hop splits that differ from our family-controlled reconstruction, and their released implementations do not permit us to retrain the corresponding models under our split.
We therefore provide these values only for historical orientation and do not use them to rank methods or support the conclusions of the graph-restoration audit.
blocks.zh:
就历史背景而言,表10将MINERVA的评价-输入微点击@1与先前报告的混合跳出PQ/PQL结果放在我们过滤的混合跳出重建上。
我们在本表中使用实例-微观汇总,是为了尽可能与以往文献中传统的实例加权报告保持一致。
UHop 和 SRN 构建了不同于我们家族控制的重建的混合跳分, 其释放的应用无法让我们在分裂下重新训练相应的模型,
因此,我们只为历史取向提供这些数值,不使用这些数值对方法进行排序,也不支持恢复图表审计的结论。

blocks.en:
The historical methods also differ in what their reported accuracy measures about multi-hop reasoning.
IRN performs iterative relation reasoning rather than explicit graph navigation.
At each hop, it predicts over a global relation vocabulary and uses the predicted relation representation to update a continuous reasoning state.
Although it can also predict intermediate entities, those entities do not become graph states whose outgoing edges define the next action space.
IRN therefore does not execute an entity-to-entity trajectory through the KG.
UHop is closer to graph navigation because its candidate relations are obtained from the current graph context and a selected relation is used to traverse the KG.
However, the model scores relation choices rather than individual outgoing relation–entity edges.
When a selected relation leads to multiple entities, the decision therefore does not identify which destination entity constitutes the next model state.
UHop consequently produces an explicit relation trajectory through the graph, but not necessarily a unique entity-by-entity trajectory of the form evaluated in our navigation setting.
SRN is more directly comparable to MINERVA because its policy selects outgoing relation–entity actions and explicitly updates the current KG entity.
Their PQ-to-PQL differences therefore should not be interpreted as measurements of a common notion of graph-navigation difficulty.
blocks.zh:
历史方法在报告的关于多跳推理的准确度度量上也有所不同.
IRN执行迭代关系推理,而不是明确的图导航.
在每次跳出时,它都会预测一个全局关系词汇,并使用所预测的关系表现来更新一个连续推理状态.
虽然它也可以预测中间实体,但这些实体不会成为图态,其出出边会定义下一个动作空间.
因此,IRN不执行实体对实体通过KG的轨迹.
UHop更接近于图导航,因为它的候选关系是从当前图文上下文获得的,并使用所选关系来穿越KG.
然而,模型对关系选择进行评分,而不是对个别外出关系-实体边缘进行评分。
当选定关系导致多个实体时,决定因此没有确定哪个目的地实体构成下一个模型状态.
UHop因此通过图表产生一个明确的关系轨迹,但不一定是我们导航环境所评价的形式的单个实体的独特轨迹。
SRN更直接地比作MIREVA,因为其政策选择了外出关系-实体动作并明确更新了目前的KG实体.
因此,它们之间的PQ--PQL差异不应被解释为对图形导航难度的共同概念的测量。

blocks.en:
The prior studies also do not isolate a single cause for their lower PQL results.
The original IRN work characterizes PQL as more challenging because it uses a larger KG with fewer training examples, while its broader relation vocabulary also changes the learned relation-prediction problem.
UHop reports a different relation-candidate distribution on PQL and finds that most PQ/PQL errors arise from relation extraction rather than termination.
SRN directly navigates outgoing KG actions, but its experiments do not separate the effects of graph structure, relation representation, training-data availability, and beam-search behavior.
We therefore treat the historical PQ-to-PQL decline as an empirical property of those published model–benchmark configurations rather than evidence that PQL is intrinsically harder to navigate.
blocks.zh:
先前的研究也并不孤立其PQL下限结果的单一原因.
最初的IRN作品将PQL定性为更具挑战性,因为它使用更大的KG并较少培训实例,而其更广泛的关系词汇也改变了所学到的关系预测问题.
UHop在PQL上报告了不同的关系-candidate分布,并发现大多数PQ/PQL错误出自关系提取而不是终止.
SRN直接导航出局的KG动作,但其实验并没有区分出图结构的效果,关系表现,训练数据可用性,和光束-搜索行为.
因此,我们把历史性的PQ-到PQL下降视为这些已公布的模型-基准配置的经验属性,而不是证明PQL在本质上更难导航的证据。

blocks.en:
Our filtered reconstruction exhibits the opposite endpoint-accuracy trend.
MINERVA obtains higher Hits@1 on PQL than on PQ, and the same direction appears for all three frozen SLM policies and the random-walk calibration in Tables 4 and 5 .
For example, RW-Ans MC rises from 0.175 0.175 on PQ to 0.541 0.541 on PQL.
Because the historical results differ from our reconstruction in splits, preprocessing, training objectives, and evaluation protocols, this reversal cannot be attributed specifically to model architecture.
Instead, it shows that benchmark name and nominal graph scale alone do not determine effective navigation difficulty.
The instantiated graph and evaluation protocol can materially change the task presented to a navigation policy.
blocks.zh:
我们经过过滤的重建显示了相反的终点准确性趋势。
MINERVA在PQL上的Hits@1比在PQ上的Hits@1要高,所有三种被冻结的可持续土地管理政策以及表4和表5中的随机行走校正都出现了同样的方向。
例如,RW-Ans MC从PQ上的0.175 0.175上升到PQL上的0.541 0541.
由于历史成果与我们的重建在分拆,预处理,培训目标,评价协议上有所不同,因此这种倒置不能具体归因于模型架构.
相反,它表明,仅靠基准名称和名义图尺度并不能确定有效的导航难度.
即时图表和评价协议可以将提交的任务实质性地改变为导航政策。

blocks.en:
The primary MINERVA comparison in Sec. 5 trains and evaluates each policy on the same active KG.
A complementary question is whether a policy trained under one graph condition transfers to the other without additional training or destination-graph tuning.
In particular, does the learned policy remain robust when the graph structure changes, or does it become specialized to its training environment even though the same released answers and annotated reference paths remain available in both KGs?
As in Tables 4 and 5 , the model entity and relation ID vocabularies are fixed across both graph conditions, so cross-graph evaluation does not introduce an out-of-vocabulary mismatch.
The transfer intervention can nevertheless expose graph structure that was absent during training, particularly when a policy trained on the filtered graph is evaluated on the restored source graph.
blocks.zh:
MINERVA在Sec. 5列车中的主要比较,并用相同的活性KG评价每项政策.
一个补充的问题是,在一个图表下培训的政策是否在没有额外培训或目的地图调图的情况下转移到另一个条件。
特别是,在图表结构发生变化时,所学到的政策是否仍然有力? 或者,尽管在两个KG中仍然有同样的解答和附加说明的参考路径,它是否专门培训环境?
和表4和表5一样,模型实体和关系ID词汇在两个图表条件之间固定,因此交叉评价不会引入出站错配.
然而,转移干预可能暴露出培训期间缺失的图表结构,特别是当经过过滤的图表培训的政策在恢复源图上得到评价时。

blocks.en:
For each training condition, hyperparameters are selected on the corresponding development graph and the resulting checkpoints are evaluated on both G F G_{F} and G S G_{S} .

blocks.en:
Tables 11 and 12 show a consistent directional asymmetry across both benchmarks.
Policies trained on G F G_{F} transfer poorly to G S G_{S} , with substantial degradation in both answer accuracy and trajectory fidelity.
In contrast, when policies trained on G S G_{S} are transferred to G F G_{F} , their answer accuracy remains comparable to or improves over their in-domain G S → G S G_{S}\rightarrow G_{S} performance, while their path fidelity improves substantially relative to the same source-graph baseline.
The graph-expansion penalty is particularly pronounced for PQL, consistent with the substantially larger change in its effective navigation search space under source restoration.
Because the released answers and reference paths remain available in both graph conditions, the degradation under graph expansion cannot be attributed to the target trajectory disappearing.
Instead, the results indicate that successful navigation on G F G_{F} depends in part on the surrounding alternatives encountered during training: when additional graph structure is restored, the learned action preferences do not remain invariant.
The reverse direction provides a useful control, since removing alternatives from a policy trained on G S G_{S} does not produce the same loss and instead tends to improve agreement with the released reference paths.
The transfer asymmetry therefore isolates sensitivity to the graph environment itself, strengthening the audit conclusion that graph construction can change the learned navigation problem even when the nominal QA targets are held fixed.
We treat this asymmetry as a transfer diagnostic for MINERVA rather than as a general claim that source-graph training necessarily improves cross-graph robustness for other navigation architectures.

blocks.en: Appendix E Preliminary Wording Audit
blocks.zh: 附录E 文字审计

blocks.en:
During reconstruction, we observed cases in which the generated natural-language question did not faithfully reflect the semantics of its released reasoning path.
To assess whether these examples were isolated, we conducted an exploratory LLM-assisted audit of the released PQ-2H.txt , PQ-3H.txt , PQL-2H.txt , and PQL-3H.txt files alongside our reconstructed QA representations, using OpenAI ChatGPT (GPT-5.6 Sol, accessed September 30, 2026).
The model was instructed to preserve the original benchmark annotations rather than repair them, distinguish explicit semantic contradictions from unsupported lexical restrictions, and examine released reasoning paths and cross-question evidence whenever possible.
The prompt and outputs are provided as artifacts of this audit.
Because the audit is LLM-assisted and does not constitute exhaustive human annotation, we do not interpret its aggregate flag rates as benchmark error rates or use them as evidence for the structural claims in the main paper.
Furthermore, some classifications, particularly semantic underspecification and type-role anomalies, remain heuristic.
Nevertheless, several directly inspectable examples reveal recurring inconsistencies between the natural-language wording and the annotated reasoning structure.
blocks.zh:
在重建期间,我们看到了一些案例,其中产生的自然语言问题没有忠实地反映其所释放的推理路径的语义.
为了评估这些例子是否是孤立的,我们利用OpenAI ChatGPT(GPT-5.6 Sol,2026年9月30日访问),对发布的PQ-2H.txt、PQL-2H.txt和PQL-3H.txt文件进行了LLM协助的探索性审计。
该模型被指示保留了原始的基准说明而不是修复,区分了明显的语义矛盾和没有支持的语法限制,并尽可能审查所释放的推理路径和交叉问题证据.
及时提供产出是这次审计的文物。
由于审计是LLM辅助的,不构成详尽的人类注释,我们不将其总旗率解释为基准误差率,也不将其作为主要文件中结构性索赔的证据。
此外,一些分类,特别是语义性不足和类型-作用异常,仍然具有弹性。
然而,几个可直接检查的例子显示,自然语言的措辞与附加说明的推理结构之间一再出现不一致。

blocks.en:
PQ uses generic kinship relations, including children , parents , and spouse , but the corresponding questions sometimes replace these relations with gender-specific terms such as daughter , dad , or husband .
Such lexicalizations impose semantic restrictions not encoded by the generic relation and can directly contradict the released annotations.
For example, the Question 15 “the sex of claudius ’s husband?” follows the annotated path claudius → spouse \xrightarrow{\texttt{spouse}} aelia_paetina → gender \xrightarrow{\texttt{gender}} female .
The term husband presupposes a male spouse, whereas the annotated path explicitly identifies the intermediate entity as female.
Similarly, Question 60 “what is the princess_elizabeth_of_england ’s dad’s sex?” follows princess_elizabeth_of_england → parents \xrightarrow{\texttt{parents}} henrietta_maria_of_france → gender \xrightarrow{\texttt{gender}} female .
Here, the generic parents relation is rendered as dad , despite the annotated intermediate entity being female.
Both contradictions are directly observable within their respective released reasoning paths, without requiring external biographical verification.

这种词典化施加了语义限制,并非由通名关系所编码,并且可以直接与发布的注释相矛盾.

blocks.en:
Other inconsistencies become apparent when comparing annotations across released questions.
For example, Question 429 “the children of daughter of p_j_kennedy ?” follows p_j_kennedy → children \xrightarrow{\texttt{children}} joseph_p_kennedy_sr → children \xrightarrow{\texttt{children}} rosemary_kennedy .
Although the question describes the intermediate entity as a daughter , other released PQ annotations explicitly identify joseph_p_kennedy_sr as male.
These examples indicate that the surface wording can introduce constraints absent from, or inconsistent with, the released graph annotations.
They do not imply that every gender-specific lexicalization is incorrect, since some may agree with the corresponding entities even when the underlying relation remains generic.
blocks.zh:
其他不一致之处在比较所发布问题的说明时变得很明显。
例如,问题429“p_j_kennedy的女儿的子女?” Joseph_ p_ kennedy_sr 儿童\ x正文\ textt{儿童} (原始内容存档于2012-10-12). Rosemary_kennedy.

这些例子表明,表面措辞可能会在发布的图表说明中引入缺失或不一致的限制.
它们并不意味着每个针对性别的词汇化是不正确的,因为即使基本关系仍然是一般性的,有些实体也可能同意相应的实体的意见。

blocks.en:
PQL exhibits a different, mechanically identifiable phenomenon: distinct Freebase-style predicates can share the same visible relation phrase.
In the inspected released annotations, 125 distinct full predicates are represented by 111 surface relation phrases, with 10 phrases corresponding to more than one predicate.
For example, genre represents five distinct predicates spanning books, broadcast content, films, music albums, and television programs.
Likewise, releases represents the distinct predicates __music__album__releases , __music__record_label__releases , and __music__recording__releases .
Consequently, the generated question does not always preserve the predicate identity encoded in its released relation chain.
blocks.zh:

在被检查的已发布说明中,有111个表层关系短语代表了125个明显的完整上游,其中10个短语对应多个上游.
例如,流派代表了五个不同的上游,跨越了书籍、广播内容、电影、音乐专辑和电视节目。

A concrete example is PQL Question 1663: “what is the releases of releases of Amsterdam ’s artist?” The reconstructed instance contains two released relation chains, r2272 → \rightarrow r2204 → \rightarrow r2279 and r2272 → \rightarrow r2204 → \rightarrow r2204 ,

Thus, these cases demonstrate a reproducible loss of relation-specific information in the question wording rather than merely awkward grammatical construction.

blocks.en:
The exploratory audit also identifies compositions in which successive predicates imply incompatible semantic roles.
For example, the released question “what is the tracks of Alfred_Philippe_Roll ’s place_of_death?” follows the relation chain __people__deceased_person__place_of_death → \rightarrow __music__recording__tracks ,
with the intermediate entity Paris .
The first predicate identifies a location, whereas the second belongs to a music-recording namespace and ordinarily expects a different source-entity role.
This discrepancy is observable from the released relation names and their composition, although it does not by itself establish that the underlying KG edges are invalid.
We therefore treat such cases as possible semantic mismatches in the graph-to-language interface, rather than independently verified factual errors.
blocks.zh:
探索性审计还查明了连续上游暗示不相容语义角色的构成.
例如,公布的问题“Alfred_Philippe_Roll的死地是什么?”
与中间实体 巴黎(巴黎).
第一个上游识别出一个位置,而第二个属于音乐录音命名空间,通常期望有不同的源实体角色.
这种差异从已放出的关系名称及其构成中可以观察到,尽管它本身并不能确定基本的KG边缘无效.
因此,我们将这类案件视为图语界面中可能的语义错配,而不是独立核实的事实错误.

blocks.en:
These findings identify a separate source of ambiguity in PQ/PQL: the correspondence between natural-language questions and their annotated reasoning structures.
In PQ, gender-specific lexicalizations can impose constraints that are absent from, or contradict, the underlying relations and entity annotations.
In PQL, predicate lexicalization can obscure distinctions between relation types, while some generated questions combine predicates with potentially incompatible semantic roles.
For question-conditioned navigation, these inconsistencies matter because the question is expected to guide relation selection, yet its wording may not uniquely or faithfully specify the annotated relation chain.
Consequently, a trajectory that follows the released annotations need not fully satisfy the natural-language question, while a linguistically plausible interpretation may disagree with the released reference.
blocks.zh:
这些结论在PQ/PQL中找出了另一个模糊的来源:自然语言问题与其注释推理结构之间的对应.
在PQ中,针对不同性别的词汇化可以施加一些限制,这些限制在基本关系和实体说明中缺失或相互矛盾。
在PQL中,上游语法化可以模糊关系类型之间的区别,而一些产生的问题将上游语法与潜在的不相容语义作用结合起来.
对于有问题条件的通航,这些不一致之处之所以重要,是因为预计这个问题将指导关系选择,但其措辞可能并非独一无二或忠实地指定了附加说明的关系链.
因此,遵循所发布说明的轨迹不一定能完全满足自然语言问题,而语言上可信的解释可能与所发布的参考不一致。

blocks.en:
This distinction also qualifies the interpretation of graph-consistent evaluation.
Our graph-relative answer and path sets are defined by realizations of the released relation chains, not by independent semantic validation of the natural-language questions.
Thus, an endpoint or trajectory can be structurally consistent with the annotated chain without necessarily constituting a semantically correct answer to the question as written.
Although the exploratory audit quantifies the prevalence of flagged wording inconsistencies under its classification criteria, these flags remain to be independently validated through systematic human annotation.
Consequently, the reported counts should not be interpreted as confirmed benchmark error rates, and the audit does not establish the causal contribution of these inconsistencies to navigation accuracy or trajectory fidelity.
Importantly, the original question wording and annotations are held fixed across our filtered and source graph conditions.
We therefore preserve the released questions and annotations rather than repairing or excluding flagged instances, maintaining the matched intervention that isolates the effect of graph construction.
The wording findings remain auxiliary to this comparison and motivate future human validation of question–relation alignment, while the mechanically verifiable lexicalization collisions provide reproducible evidence of information loss in the generated questions.
blocks.zh:
这种区分也限制了对与图表一致的评价的解释。
我们的图相相接的答案和路径集是通过释放出的关系链的实现来定义的,而不是通过对自然语言问题的独立语义验证来定义的.
因此,一个端点或轨迹在结构上可以与附加说明的链条一致,而不一定构成对所写问题的完全正确的答案。
虽然探索性审计量化了其分类标准下标出措辞不一致的普遍程度,但这些旗帜仍需通过系统的人文注释进行独立验证.
因此,所报告的计数不应被解释为确认的基准出错率,审计没有确定这些不一致对导航准确性或轨迹可靠性的因果关系。
重要的是,最初的问题措辞和说明被固定在我们过滤过的和来源的图表条件中。
因此,我们保留了所公布的问题和说明,而不是修复或排除标出的例子,而是保持了隔离图表构建效果的对应干预。
措辞调查结果仍然有助于这种比较,并激励今后人类验证问题-关系对接,而机械可核查的词汇化相撞则为所产生的问题提供了信息损失的可复制证据。

blocks.en: Appendix F Cautions for Interpreting PQ/PQL Results
blocks.zh: 附录F 解释PQ/PQL结果的注意事项

blocks.en:
PQ/PQL remain useful controlled benchmarks, but several properties of their released artifacts limit the conclusions that can be drawn from performance on them.
This appendix summarizes those interpretive boundaries rather than restating the empirical comparisons reported in Section 5 .
blocks.zh:
PQ/PQL仍然是有用的受控基准,但其被放出文物的多处属性限制了从它们的性能上可以得出的结论.
本附录概述了这些解释性边界,而不是重复第5节所汇报的经验性比较。

blocks.en:
A result obtained on the released task-filtered graph should be interpreted as performance within that particular navigation environment.
It should not, without additional evidence, be extrapolated to navigation or retrieval over the larger source KG from which the benchmark was derived.
For retrieval-based systems, this distinction is especially important because the released graph already restricts which entities, relations, and edges are available before retrieval begins.
Accordingly, strong performance on PQ/PQL does not by itself demonstrate robustness to substantially larger candidate spaces or denser graph neighborhoods.
blocks.zh:
在所释放的任务过滤图上获得的结果应被解释为该特定导航环境中的性能。
如果没有其他证据,它不应被推断为在基准来源较大的KG上进行导航或取回。
对于基于检索的系统,这种区分特别重要,因为发布的图表已经限制了哪些实体,关系,和边缘在检索开始前可以使用.
因此,在PQ/PQL上的强劲表现本身并不能表明对大得多的候选空间或更密集的图表街区的强烈性。

blocks.en:
Graph-consistent answers and paths certify consistency with the released relation chains under the active graph, not independent semantic correctness of the natural-language question.
As Appendix E illustrates, mechanically generated PQ/PQL questions can express constraints or ambiguities that are not captured by those structural annotations.
Released answers, graph-consistent answers, and answers justified by the full surface semantics should therefore not be treated as interchangeable notions of correctness.
blocks.zh:
图形一致的答案和路径验证与活性图下释放出的关系链的一致性,而不是自然语言问题的独立语义正确性.
作为附录 E说明,机械生成的PQ/PQL问题可以表示这些结构说明所没有的制约或模糊性。
因此,不应将释放的答案、与图表一致的答案和完全表面语义证明合理的答案视为可互换的正确性概念。

blocks.en:
A correct endpoint should not be interpreted as evidence that the released reasoning trajectory was followed.
Conversely, disagreement with one released path does not establish that a trajectory is structurally invalid when another graph-consistent realization exists.
Endpoint correctness and trajectory agreement should therefore be evaluated separately when making claims about navigation or reasoning behavior.
blocks.zh:
正确的终点不应被解释为证明所释放的推理轨迹得到遵守的证据。
反之,与一个已放出路径的分歧并不能确定当另一个与图形一致的实现存在时,一个轨道在结构上无效.
因此,在对导航或推理行为提出索赔时,应分别评估终点正确性和轨迹协议。

blocks.en:
The annotated hop count describes the released reference walk rather than the minimum number of actions required to reach a valid answer.
As Appendix A.2 shows, cyclic or self-returning references and topic–answer identity can admit shorter correct routes, including zero-action solutions.
Claims about reasoning depth should therefore not be based on the nominal 2-hop or 3-hop label alone.
blocks.zh:
附加说明的hop计数描述了发布的参考行走,而不是达到有效答案所需的最小动作数.
如附录A.2所示,循环或自回的引用和话题-答题身份可以接受更短的正确路径,包括零动作解决方案.
因此,关于推理深度的说法不应仅以名义上的2-hop或3-hop标签为依据。

blocks.en:
Published PQ/PQL results may use different hop-specific or mixed-hop reconstructions, graph artifacts, action definitions, stopping conventions, inverse relations, candidate limits, answer aggregation rules, and path-reference handling.
Trainable navigation systems can additionally differ in which graph condition is used for training and hyperparameter selection.
Consequently, results labeled simply as “PQ” or “PQL” should not be assumed directly comparable unless these choices are sufficiently aligned.
Studies using these benchmarks should identify the graph artifact and preprocessing used and state how multiple answers, multiple paths, repeated entities, stopping actions, and aggregation are handled.
blocks.zh:
已公布的PQ/PQL结果可能使用不同的hop特异性或混合hop重建,图解文物,动作定义,停止常规,逆向关系,候选限制,解答汇总规则,以及路径参考处理.
可训练导航系统在培训和超参数选择中使用的图表条件方面可能有所不同。
因此,仅仅标为“PQ”或“PQL”的结果,不应被假定为直接可比,除非这些选择充分一致。
使用这些基准进行的研究应确定所使用的图件和预处理,并说明如何处理多个答案、多路径、重复的实体、停止行动和汇总。

blocks.en:
These cautions do not invalidate results obtained on the released PQ/PQL benchmarks.
They instead delimit what those results directly support.
PQ/PQL remain useful controlled benchmarks for studying relation composition and graph navigation when their graph, annotation, and language conventions are made explicit.
Claims about source-KG robustness, retrieval difficulty, unique reasoning explanations, required reasoning depth, or fine-grained natural-language understanding require additional evidence beyond performance on the released benchmark alone.
blocks.zh:
这些警告并没有使公布的PQ/PQL基准获得的结果失效。
相反,它们界定了这些结果直接支持的内容。
PQ/PQL仍然是研究关系构成和图表导航的有用控制基准,当其图表、注释和语言惯例得到明确。
关于源-KG稳健性、检索困难、独特的推理解释、必要的推理深度或精细的自然语言理解的主张,需要额外的证据,而不只是在所公布的基准上表现。
